metadata.description: Plugins built on the sci-ai-enabler knowledge base for life scientists.

plugins.name: composer
plugins.description: Turn a plain-language scientific problem into a grounded, runnable Claude solution — composed from the cataloged Skills/MCP servers/Plugins, reusing a curated recipe when one fits, and recommending a pre-built autonomous system when that's the right call.

plugins.name: crucible
plugins.description: Hypothesis Crucible — agentic cross-corpus hypothesis generation. Mines typed knowledge fragments from literature, structured databases, and raw experimental data; bridges them Swanson-style into novel connections; then runs a falsification gauntlet of independent veto gates that aggressively rejects non-novel, ungrounded, contradicted, or implausible ideas, surfacing only survivors with cited support and a discriminating experimental test.
